$comment: Table T-061 LR-6: Entity and UseCase must not touch a type the browser
supplies. A name-based screen would only guess, so the compiler enforces it:
these two layers are compiled here WITHOUT the DOM library and without the
Node types, which turns `document`, `window`, `HTMLElement` and the rest into
type errors rather than something review has to catch.
Run together with the root tsconfig: `npm run typecheck`.
